messages.author: f6d12b388faad456
messages.subject: Re: Monte Carlo to estimate sample size for CFA and SEM.
parts:
Hi, John,

Not sure if I understood your question.
simsem has 2 functions to estimate power: a structural power (e.g.: power to accept the model through RMSEA, CFI, TLI, etc.), and a parameter power (your image).
From what I remember, you have to inform what is the sample size you wish to estimate power for in these functions. Further, have you simulated a single sample size (e.g.: n = 200) or more than one (e.g.: n=c(200,400,600))?

Best,
Yago
